features.title: Kernel (pure Kotlin + TypeScript core)
features.summary: The framework core every app gets: asset registry, engines, runtime state, actions, module system. Pure Kotlin on Android (no Android imports, KMP-ready); framework/core on the web.
capabilities: Hot-swappable assets for every visual slot
Runtime state with persistence of the user's choices
Kernel API level 1 with semver + deprecations

acceptance.text: Compiled in CI on every push
Python port passes the same fixtures

recommendations: Keep the kernel free of Android imports so a Kotlin Multiplatform desktop port stays possible
Bump API_LEVEL only for breaking contract changes; add capabilities instead

First real compile: 0 kernel errors; fixed JS number formatting for conformance

features.title: Asset system (asset@1, 13 core types, open registry)

features.title: Engines: theme, layout, component styles, UAC, context menu, actions

acceptance.text: Theme CSS variables match the reference engine byte for byte

features.title: Porting spec + conformance fixtures

features.title: Module system: modules, extension points, services, placeholders
features.summary: Modules register screens, actions, settings, dialogs, services and UI kits through extension points, start in dependency order and can define their own extension points. Placeholders answer NotImplemented until a real module arrives.

Add modules without rebuilding the kernel
